facets.name: docstring
facets.description: the declaration's docstring, verbatim (project nodes, and upstream nodes unless the extractor ran with --no-upstream-docs)

facets.name: source
facets.description: where the declaration is written: path relative to the project root, start and end as [line, column] (lines 1-based, columns in UTF-16 code units, 0-based), and the keyword it is written with

facets.name: axioms
facets.description: the axioms the declaration depends on, transitively, and whether `sorryAx` is among them

facets.name: annotation.characterization
facets.description: `@[characterization]` annotations recorded in the TrustAnnotations extension: for each declaration, the payload of each application, in order

facets.name: annotation.claim
facets.description: `@[claim]` annotations recorded in the TrustAnnotations extension: for each declaration, the payload of each application, in order

facets.name: annotation.domain
facets.description: `@[domain]` annotations recorded in the TrustAnnotations extension: for each declaration, the payload of each application, in order

facets.name: annotation.example_of
facets.description: `@[example_of]` annotations recorded in the TrustAnnotations extension: for each declaration, the payload of each application, in order

facets.name: annotation.nonexample_of
facets.description: `@[nonexample_of]` annotations recorded in the TrustAnnotations extension: for each declaration, the payload of each application, in order

facets.name: annotation.specifies
facets.description: `@[specifies]` annotations recorded in the TrustAnnotations extension: for each declaration, the payload of each application, in order

facets.name: signature
facets.description: every node's signature as Lean prints it (`name (x : α) … : β`), for hovers; with `refs`, as in the statement facet

facets.name: statement
facets.description: the declaration's statement taken apart: its binders (name, pretty-printed type, role: type, variable, hypothesis or instance), the conclusion under them, and for a definition its body, for a structure its fields, for another inductive type its constructors; pretty-printed by Lean, `⋯` marking what a bounded printer cut; with each text, `refs`: the span and name of each constant it names, and with each binder the `head` constant of its type. Project nodes, and with an upstream closure the upstream nodes it reached that are not proofs

edges.name: statement
edges.description: the declarations the declaration's type mentions, proofs erased, looking through helpers (rule ltb-meaning/1)

edges.name: meaning
edges.description: what the declaration means, under the rule ltb-meaning/1: the declarations its content mentions, proofs erased everywhere, looking through helpers. A proof's content is its statement; a definition's, its statement and value; an inductive type's, its type and constructors. The closure over these edges is what coverage is computed over, and what the meaning hash covers

edges.name: term
edges.description: the type and the whole value, proofs included, restricted to targets that are nodes

edges.name: source
edges.description: what the declaration's source needs that its elaborated term does not mention: the coercion instances it relies on, and for a notation what it expands to
